summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SMS and Scheduled Reports features. All 19 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing verified all 3 tabs: SMS Settings, Report Scheduling, and Send Logs. All tabs load correctly and display data from APIs.

notification_settings_page.details: Page loads at /notification-settings with title 'إعدادات الإشعارات والتقارير' and 3 tabs with proper data-testid attributes

sms_settings_tab.details: Tab shows Tamimah SMS settings form with API URL, username, password, sender ID fields. Save button works. Shows 'مكوّن' (Configured) badge when settings are saved.

sms_send_test.details: Test SMS section shows phone number input and message textarea. Send button works. SMS logs show failed status (expected - no real Tamimah credentials configured).

report_schedules_tab.details: Tab shows schedules table with columns: Name, Report Type, Frequency, Time, Recipients, Status, Last Sent. Add Schedule button visible. Existing schedule 'التقرير اليومي' displayed with toggle and action buttons.

send_logs_tab.details: Tab shows two sections: SMS logs (سجل الرسائل النصية) and Report logs (سجل التقارير المرسلة). SMS log shows test message with failed status.

sms_settings_api.details: GET/POST /api/sms/settings work correctly. Password is hidden in response (********). is_configured flag properly set.

sms_send_api.details: POST /api/sms/send validates required fields (phone, message). Returns success/failure status. Logs all attempts to sms_logs collection.

sms_logs_api.details: GET /api/sms/logs returns list of SMS logs with phone, message, status, sent_at fields.

report_schedules_crud_api.details: Full CRUD operations work: GET /api/reports/schedules, POST create, PUT update, DELETE. Schedule includes name, report_type, frequency, day_of_week, day_of_month, time, recipients, is_active.

report_schedule_run_api.details: POST /api/reports/schedules/{id}/run triggers report generation. Returns success/error based on SMTP configuration. 404 for nonexistent schedule.

report_logs_api.details: GET /api/reports/logs returns list of report logs with schedule_id, report_type, recipients, status, sent_at fields.

critical_code_review_comments: SMS integration with Tamimah is properly implemented but requires real credentials to send actual messages
Report scheduling works but email sending requires SMTP configuration (already configured in .env)
Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1) on dashboard - not related to notification settings but should be addressed
updated_files: /app/tests/test_sms_and_reports_schedules.py - Created comprehensive tests for SMS and Report Schedules APIs

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 tabs working, navigation, data display, forms)

seed_data_creation: Created test SMS settings with test_user credentials. Created and deleted test schedules during API testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification Settings page fully tested: 1) SMS Settings tab with Tamimah SMS integration (API URL, username, password, sender ID), test SMS sending, 2) Report Schedules tab with CRUD operations for daily/weekly/monthly reports (daily_summary, weekly_summary, monthly_financial, inventory_alerts), 3) Send Logs tab showing SMS and Report sending history. All APIs working correctly. SMS requires real Tamimah credentials to send actual messages. SMTP configured for email reports. No mocked APIs.
